name: Hajenius, Rokin 92-96
surveyedSource: 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell of BAG pand 0363100012168350 (3DBAG CC BY 4.0, BAG CC0) in native east/south metres (scripts/landmarks/hajenius-rokin-footprints.json, bag-shell-prepare.ts); the 27.3 m Rokin front read from whole-face rectified Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas recording_2025-06-16_06-42-40_01743 (2025, 36 px/m) and TMX7316010203-000709_pano_0000_001134 (2018), CC BY 4.0; heights fitted to the 3DBAG's 70th-percentile roof (the Hajenius cornice, 20.1 m). The pand also holds the cream bell-gable house on the lane corner and the black neck-gable house beside it; both are drawn. Per wall in scripts/landmarks/hajenius-rokin-inventory.json.

attribution.title: Rokin 92-96, Amsterdam: the Hajenius tobacco house (BAG 1914) with the cream bell-gable house and the black neck-gable house on the same pand
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012168350 (CC0): the sandstone Hajenius front with its pilasters, paterae, three-light windows with sun blinds, red awnings, carved door cartouche, curved end gable with oculus and mansard dormers; the cream house's bell gable, balconies and striped markiezen; the black house's neck gable and white-framed windows, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0). No pixels or meshes imported.
